messages:
Maria: Kickoff for ArtemisAI reserved pool bring-up tomorrow 09:00 PDT. Quota baseline 120k tokens/min, burst to 180k. Pool = 4x p4d-equivalent. Need SRE + Runtime Eng + CS on the war room. Load-test + autoscale + fallback plan below.

Lee: Ack. I'll provision autoscale policy: metric=queries_per_min, target_util=0.65, cooldown=2m. Who owns latency SLO for this customer?

Tom: Recommend SLO = p50 < 150ms token gen for short chats, p95 < 500ms. For bursts route to v2-quant, fallback to v2-q8 when memory pressure spikes. I'll prepare a canary at 10% traffic.

Anya: Artemis confirmed their client warmup script and will rotate API keys tonight. They asked for a 30-min handover and a quick KMS access test (they use GCP KMS).

Maria: Plan sketch:
- 08:00 infra smoke (node health + network)
- 08:30 pool priming (KV prefix warm + small prefix-cache replay)
- 08:45 30-min customer handover w/ Artemis devs
- 09:00 ramp: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 60m (stepper: 10m increments)
- 10:15 chaos test: drain 1 node, verify autoscale & fallbacks
- 11:00 start 2h soak at target load
Load profile (k6):
```
export default function () {
  http.post(__ENV.TARGET + '/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'qa', max_tokens: 64 }));
}
```
Use gradual ramp: 50 -> 250 VUs over 60m.

Lee: I'll add an alert for queue length > 500 and avg latency > 1.2s. If triggered we route 20% to hosted fallback with token attribution. Also adding a short cooldown to avoid flapping.

WarmupBot: Reminder scheduled: "Artemis reserved pool priming" at 2024-05-27T08:00:00Z — runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-priming. :bell:

Tom: Enabling prefix KV caching and model-level cache layers. Please ensure client prefixes are stable for effective cache hits. Also will ship a canary config:
```yaml
canary: 10%
model_variant: v2-quant
fallback: v2-q8
```

Anya: Artemis asked what happens if quota is hit mid-ramp. Proposal: auto-reroute to hosted with graceful 429->302 style, plus immediate notif to CS and customer slack. Should we block user-facing degradation for first 30m?

Lee: We can implement policy: when queue>500 && token_rate > quota*0.95 then route to hosted (tier=shared) and cut incoming new sessions if sustained >5m. We'll surface telemetry to CS dashboard.

Maria: Action items: @Lee = patch autoscale + routing rules + alerts; @Tom = prepare canary + KV warm scripts; @Anya = schedule handover invite + validate KMS test with Artemis. War room link will be posted 30m before start. :rocket:

Anya: :thumbsup: I'll invite Artemis devs to 08:45 handover, send runbook excerpt, and confirm KMS access now. If anything blocks I'll DM.

Tom: Quick note for SREs — when you see priming traffic use header X-Priming: artemis-v1 so we can filter in logs.

Lee: Copy. I'll also run a dry-run autoscale simulation tonight against staging with the same load profile.

Maria: Great. See you all tomorrow.
